wording.formIntro: Our virtual assistant (an AI) replies on this page, usually in under 10 seconds, finds open times from the demo calendar and books your appointment.
wording.formPlaceholder: Example: a haircut and blowout for shoulder-length hair, any day next week.

wording.askService: what would you like to book (for example a cut, color, a blowout or event styling)?
